what: Pairs of sources a search's chips may hold. `same_chip`: the page (web/tagpup/search-model.js memberKey) treats them as one chip, so a second is not added. Whatever the page calls one chip, the server must read as the same photos (tests/test_chip_keys_follow_the_server.py: tagpup.services.library_view); the page may be finer than the server (two chips for what the server reads alike) but never coarser. {folder} is a folder the test's library holds.

pairs.name: a tag alone in another case
a tag and the same tag alone
a person and the tag they are filed under
a folder and the folder with what is under it
a year as a number and as text
